title: Audit both coupled P104 helper observations in edit 26
body:
**The two coupled observations in edit 26 of [PR #7756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7756) pass a separate exact implementation check.** Each chart can observe exactly its stated source direction, and both incoming disturbances cancel at both affected terminals. Two explicit rank-seven minors, each with determinant `1/512`, certify the complete local intersections. **No new kappa** or whole-supplier acceptance is claimed.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10d665e8230712f7144952079b626f7bcb6e8dbe/research/p104-coupled-observation-audit/PROOF.md), [complete bank and rank certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10d665e8230712f7144952079b626f7bcb6e8dbe/research/p104-coupled-observation-audit/RESULT.json), [forward propagation and determinant code](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10d665e8230712f7144952079b626f7bcb6e8dbe/research/p104-coupled-observation-audit/audit.py), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10d665e8230712f7144952079b626f7bcb6e8dbe/research/p104-coupled-observation-audit/verify.py), [31 source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10d665e8230712f7144952079b626f7bcb6e8dbe/research/p104-coupled-observation-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10d665e8230712f7144952079b626f7bcb6e8dbe/research/p104-coupled-observation-audit/CREDITS.md).

| Receiver | Exact local observation | Response to `(u,v)` | Repaired terminal |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Chart 144 | `(bank101949-bank101940)/2 = x1149-x1152/2` | `-(u+v)/2` | 130 |
| Chart 177 | `2*(bank101943-bank101937) = (x1152-x1151)/2` | `(-u+v)/2` | 166 |

The audit enumerates all six banks at each chart and propagates all 1,262 public coefficients plus both pulse columns. The 904-node required graph gives 15,144 complete bank coefficients. Each rank certificate includes its seven public row labels, seven columns, full minor and exact determinant. It proves that no second direction in the stated two-equation plane is locally observable. The other two terminals on these charts have zero response to both impulses.

The journal's first pulse acts at 101324 and half as strongly at 101902; the second acts at 99605 and half as strongly at 100008. All four route coefficients matter. Flipping any one leaves a nonzero residual after the prescribed repairs. Two flipped observation coefficients break the all-input source identities. The controls inspect the complete repaired expression: a changed companion arrival can change the observation while leaving the terminal response unchanged.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-coupled-observation-audit
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_P104_COUPLED_OBSERVATION_AUDIT
1262 public fields; 12 complete bank rows; two rank-seven minors
chart 144: (-1/2,-1/2); chart 177: (-1/2,1/2); both terminal errors cancel
four pulse-sign and two observation-sign controls; unchanged local source check passes
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44423939856/job/135223779708) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the source [construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/construction.py), [journal](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/EDITS.json), [two-receiver proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/PROOF.md) and [local checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/witness.py). The new forward integer-vector calculation does not use that checker's entrance, pulse or row-space routines. The unchanged source local checker runs afterwards as a reverse-expansion cross-check. Both paths share the pinned constructor through edit 25. That constructor is a dependency, not a newly verified theorem here.

The source builds on [PR #7726](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7726). Its preserved [credit record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/CREDITS.md) and [parent notices](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/credits/7726-CREDITS.md) credit Clear1nsight, DreamingOfClouds with Claude assistance, SYLforge, Rohan Arun, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt and the retained lineage. All 31 files, including sixteen predecessor notices, are retained byte for byte. The contribution is prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing; Apache-2.0.

Scope is the two specified source equations, twelve banks and two pulses before edit 26. Other source constraints, changed banks and the other lanes are outside the exclusion. The full 32-edit witness, whole native operator, physical catalogue, mixed caller, interval price gate, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. The complete conditional bound remains a source claim. All five assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. Separate code paths do not constitute independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

No unmerged ancestry is asserted.
